messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Triplet: ["Omeprazole", "reduces", "stomach acid production"]

The relation 'reduces' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug decreases the amount of the biological substance specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
B. 'has inactive ingredient': The subject drug contains the inactive substance specified by the object entity.
C. 'requires gradual dose reduction': The subject drug must be reduced in dose slowly over the time period specified by the object entity to avoid adverse effects.
D. 'can pass into': The subject drug can transfer into the biological fluid or substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'has discontinuation rate': A specified percentage of patients discontinue use of the subject drug as indicated by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
